title: Domestic HellLand
subtitle: A Catholic school girl makes a mock-deal with the Devil. 2 years later, when she’s LEGAL and no longer in school, Satan appears to fulfill and collect his contractual obligations. However, the Devil doesn’t meet initial expectations: he’s an old man with an accent, long hair and a 70’s muscle car. Even worse, he’s grumpy and intentionally low profile— a total mood killer!
